query: How can educators improve learning satisfaction?

per_column.name: teacher_instructional_quality
per_column.rationale: Directly relevant axis for improving satisfaction; distinguishes adaptive vs passive teaching. Values are well-grounded readings of the text (e.g. ED-0002 'high_adaptive' from creative labs, ED-0003 'low_passive' from teacher unable to tell when child is lost). ED-0001 'adequate_functional' is a defensible neutral read given the issue is technical, not the teacher.

per_column.name: engagement_modality
per_column.rationale: Modality (live/async/mixed) is a useful grouping axis for what formats drive satisfaction. However grounding is shaky: ED-0004 explicitly describes recorded lectures yet elsewhere the pattern of defaulting to 'live_interactive' is questionable, and ED-0003 labeled 'live_interactive' when the text only mentions a platform logging out with no clear live component. Some values assert a specific modality the text does not clearly support.

per_column.name: peer_social_interaction_quality
per_column.rationale: Peer interaction is a strong, distinct lever for satisfaction. Values track the text well: ED-0003 'absent' (zero peer interaction stated), ED-0005 'absent' (silent chat). ED-0004 'not_applicable' is a reasonable silent-row read. ED-0001 'minimal_awkward' is a mild inference from 'raise my hand quietly' but defensible.

per_column.name: student_disengagement_pattern
per_column.rationale: Useful behavioral axis for diagnosing dissatisfaction. Mostly grounded (ED-0005 'cameras_off_silent' matches text exactly). But ED-0003 'disappeared_from_roster' contradicts the text, which shows the child still attending sessions and crying, not disappearing. ED-0001 'cameras_off_silent' is not supported by the source, which describes technical freezing, not cameras off.

per_column.name: subject_format_fit
per_column.rationale: How well a subject suits the online format is a strong modeling axis for satisfaction. Values are reasonable inferences: ED-0004 'high_fit_digital_native' (history via video/clips), ED-0003 'low_fit_needs_physical' (early reading needing hands-on support). ED-0001 'low_fit_needs_physical' for algebra is a bit arguable but warranted given the whiteboard dependence.

judge.rationale: The added columns collectively provide genuinely distinct and analytically valuable axes—teaching quality, delivery modality, peer interaction, disengagement behavior, and subject-format fit—each offering real leverage for grouping and modeling drivers of learning satisfaction. None are near-constant, redundant, or generic. Groundedness is generally sound but weakened by several unsupported or contradictory categorical assignments, notably in engagement_modality (defaulting to live_interactive against textual cues) and student_disengagement_pattern (ED-0003 'disappeared_from_roster' and ED-0001 'cameras_off_silent' contradict their source text). These are confident specifics where the text points elsewhere, dragging groundedness below the usefulness score.
